title: Publish chattic.us Next.js UI to AWS
description:
Definition of Done:
- chattic.us resolves to the production web distribution over HTTPS with a valid ACM certificate.
- Staging and development have named web origins (subdomains documented in SSM).
- The browser loads the UI and calls the thin-turn API at /api/* on the same origin (no separate api subdomain).
- Deploy is repeatable from GitHub Actions (OIDC) or documented manual cdk deploy; no Amplify, no CodePipeline.
- README What is live today reflects the web surface.

Architecture: Next.js on S3 behind CloudFront default behavior; /api/* behavior proxies to the thin-turn Lambda function URL with prefix strip. One distribution per environment owns the public hostname.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
**Handoff to local agent (2026-08-31):** Cloud agent completed implementation on branch `cursor/implement-web-aws-182a` (PR #32) but cannot deploy — this VM has no AWS credentials (`aws sts get-caller-identity` fails; only `OPENAI_API_KEY` is in cloud secrets). Partial `aws login` sessions in `~/.aws/cli/cache/session.db` were never completed.

Local agent with `aws login` (account `335163751677`, `us-east-1`) should deploy in order:
1. `cd infra && sh deploy-chatticus-dns.sh` → copy **NameServers** output
2. User sets those four NS at GoDaddy (only manual step)
3. Wait for ACM DNS validation after delegation
4. `sh deploy-chatticus-web-development.sh` (thin-turn + web)
5. Verify `curl https://dev.chattic.us/api/health` and open `https://dev.chattic.us`

Merge PR #32 to `develop` first if not already merged.
